question_1.text: Which type of malware disguises itself as a useful program?

question_2.text: What is the main job of a firewall?
choices: C. Monitor and control network traffic
D. Remove every infected file automatically

question_3.text: How do a firewall and antivirus work together?
choices: A. The firewall controls traffic, while antivirus checks files and behavior
B. The firewall creates backups, while antivirus installs updates
C. The firewall stores passwords, while antivirus blocks advertisements
D. They perform exactly the same job

question_4.text: Which habit provides the best everyday protection against malware?
choices: A. Turning off the firewall when an app requests it
B. Downloading free software from unknown websites
C. Ignoring updates until the device stops working
D. Installing updates and downloading only from trusted sources
